_description: E-050: WARM-START QUANTIZATION — the approved repair for road B's cold-start collapse. Field-for-field ml/recipes/f4r2-40M-dz6-fsq65k.json (E-049b: d_z 6, FSQ [8,8,8,5,5,5] = one 2^16 token per pixel-bin, fitted auto ladder, LayerNorm bound) plus exactly ONE new key: fsq_warmstart 'true'. The dispatch that uses this recipe MUST set resume '!run-480' (the finished E-049a continuous d_z-6 control, 200k steps, published as run-480__pixelmae.pt on model-checkpoints-v1 2026-08-26) and codec_steps 260000 (= 200k resumed + 60k warm steps). MECHANISM: the lattice and the ln bound are PARAMETER-FREE — E-049 measured 37,956,471 params on both arms — so every weight of the trained continuous encoder loads exactly and only the bottleneck's FUNCTION changes; --fsq-warmstart opens the resume guard's one approved hole (CONTINUOUS -> FSQ, nothing else) and REBASES fsq_auto_step onto the resumed step, so the fits land at +50/+200/+2000/+20000/+60000 warm steps against a settled, input-dependent z distribution instead of a random init. WHY THIS SHOULD NOT COLLAPSE WHERE #481/#482 DID: the cold-start collapse was a DIRECTION collapse under an intact scale (persistence z-MSE -> exactly 0, fit std_med 0.638 -> 0.005 by 7.5k) — the encoder had not yet learned input-dependent directions when the lattice's straight-through gradients arrived; here the directions are the finished run-480 encoder's, already spread (its fits read input-dependent std throughout 200k steps). A9 is the shape precedent: head-side quantization worked ON AN EXISTING Z (0.4916 < 0.5056 control) while every cold-start codec-side FSQ run collapsed or degenerated. FIRST-MINUTES HEALTH SIGNALS, in order: (1) the trainer's FSQ WARM START banner naming fsq_warmstart_from=run-480.pt@200000; (2) fit records at +50/+200 with prequant_rms 1.0 AND std_med staying INPUT-DEPENDENT (O(0.1-1), NOT ->0.005 — the #482 signature); (3) ml/fsq_usage.py effective bits on the first milestone (a sign-code degeneration reads ~6 bits of 16). collapse_r stays '0' (uncalibrated on lattice z — #481's false-fire threshold analysis in the fsq65k recipe stands); the replacement monitor is the same fit-record + effective-bits pair, now with the run-480 fits as the healthy reference trace. VERDICT INSTRUMENT unchanged from E-049b and pre-registered there: the non-linear decoder audit (recon_eval full-visibility FVU + recon_decoder E-019b1 decoder-only retrain ceiling) on the per-(t,pixel) Argo-bin split; FAIL = any fast channel at ~100% FVU at the ceiling on Argo-free bins. NOTE THE CONFOUND, DECLARED: the warm arm totals 260k steps against #480's 200k, so (warm-b − a) is quantization tax PLUS 60k extra steps; the falsifier is absolute (the 9–19%% FVU band), not a training-matched contrast, and a PASS close to the band edge buys a 260k continuous control before any tax number is quoted. COST ~4.5 h train (0.252 s/step measured on #482) + probes ≈ $2-3 on the 24 GB tier. Plan: ml/plans/E050_warmstart_fsq.md; log anchor e-050.
